name: vibeschool-resource-conservation
description: Minimize unnecessary VibeSchool CI, deploy, paid-AI, external-provider and destructive operations without weakening proof.
---
# Resource Conservation
Prefer repository inspection, focused tests, cached/current evidence and deterministic checks before expensive CI/deploy/provider calls. Rerun only failed/affected jobs where safe. Avoid unnecessary production mutations and paid AI. Conservation never weakens security, authorization, exact-head certification, required independent assurance or production verification; choose the cheapest proof that still meets the evidence contract.
